contract_assertions.assertion: The orchestrator chooses conservative route actions and blocks protected-path findings from unattended direct PR dispatch.
The CLI fetches unrouted findings, inspects open GitHub issues, and can dry-run or persist route actions through the #240 ledger.
The GitHub workflow supports schedule and workflow_dispatch entrypoints and reuses the existing Codex PR engine.

cross_env_matrix.environment: local CLI dry-run with live Worker ledger on http://localhost:8788
cross_env_matrix.notes: Validated conservative route decisions without creating GitHub issues or dispatching PRs.

notes: This run validates the orchestrator logic locally on top of the stacked #240 branch.
It does not prove a remote GitHub Actions run against main because main does not yet include the #240 Worker ledger endpoints.

portability.summary: Portable from repo state plus documented setup.
notes: No reviewer-facing UI proof was required because #241 is a control-plane API/workflow issue.
Dry-run inspected two seeded findings and correctly separated direct-pr from human-review scope.
